house.description: Litchfield; wastewater industrial pretreatment facility funding provided, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; WASTEWATER INDUSTRIAL PRETREATMENT FACILITY. +]

[+$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the First District Association, a dairy cooperative located in the city of Litchfield to design, engineer, construct, equip, and furnish a new wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield. This appropriation is in addition to the appropriation in Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 7, and is for the same purpose. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WASTEWATER INDUSTRIAL PRETREATMENT FACILITY.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the First District Association, a dairy cooperative located in the city of Litchfield to design, engineer, construct, equip, and furnish a new wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield. This appropriation is in addition to the appropriation in Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 7, and is for the same purpose.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the First District Association, a dairy cooperative located in the city of Litchfield to design, engineer, construct, equip, and furnish a new wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield. This appropriation is in addition to the appropriation in Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 7, and is for the same purpose.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
